prompt:
A sheet of 16 pixel-art icons for a dark fantasy tactical RPG, in the style of detailed 16-bit SNES/GBA-era RPG icons. Square 1:1 image, an exact 4 by 4 grid of 16 equal square tiles separated by thin straight gutters of pure black (#000000), no outer border beyond the gutters. Each tile is one icon on its own rounded-square tile filled with the colour named for it, with a subtle darker vignette. Every icon is drawn large and centred, with clear dark outlines, hand-placed pixel clusters, a limited palette with 4 shades per colour, a warm light from the upper left and a thin warm rim light. The icons show mage and priest skills and the fallback icons per kind, each showing the action itself so it reads at a glance at small size. No text, no letters, no numbers, no labels, no frame, no watermark. Row by row, left to right:
Row 1: a blue bolt of raw arcane force flying forward (tile deep dark red); a thrown clay pot bursting into fire (tile deep dark red); a purple cursed sigil on a cracked mask (tile deep dark red); a straight lance of crackling lightning (tile deep dark red).
Row 2: a roaring burst of flames over an area (tile deep dark red); a burst of ice shards freezing the ground (tile deep dark red); a glowing gold shield sigil over a figure (tile deep dark green); a green healing swirl with small leaves (tile deep dark green).
Row 3: a dazed head with a spiral above it (tile deep dark purple); a plain sword and axe crossed (any attack) (tile deep dark red); a plain bow with a nocked arrow (any ranged attack) (tile deep dark red); a plain glowing wand tip with sparks (any spell) (tile deep dark red).
Row 4: an open hand with a soft green glow (any support) (tile deep dark green); a plain round shield (any defence) (tile deep dark blue); a figure stepping back away from a blade (any disengage) (tile deep dark teal); a swirl of purple status motes (any status) (tile deep dark purple).
note: --no-ref inferred, not recorded: the option was added in this same commit for the icon sheets, and the prompt asks for no portrait style
